name: canon
description: Canon — a curated catalog of design skills for AI agents, packaged as installable kits.

plugins.name: canon
plugins.description: A router skill plus three design kits: marketing and landing sites, product UI and dashboards, and mobile-first review. Install once, invoke deliberately.

plugins.name: graft
plugins.description: Session cartography: render any Claude Code session as a branch map. Trunk, forks, compactions, one HTML file out.

plugins.name: strata
plugins.description: A record of what users actually said, in layers. Files feedback by date under pseudonyms, keeps verbatim apart from interpretation, and refuses to call two people a pattern.

plugins.name: deter
plugins.description: Less, but better. A review that removes — every finding priced against the surface's job, one thing kept, at most one thing missing, and never an unrequested rewrite.
